posts.title: Practical Ways AI Can Help You Today with Minimal Setup
posts.description: There is a lot of hype around AI right now, and I was a skeptic for a long time as many close friends know. In the past it required precise prompts that were long-winded, and even then you didn’t always get the result you wanted. posts.title: Attaching a debugger to a Windows Containerd shim
posts.description: Containerd provides a mechanism that allows runtime authors to integrate with containerd via the shim api .
